input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
input.rationale: The grant is perpetual (Section 17(a)) and terminable only for uncured material default (Section 17(c)(7)), so it is not revocable at Garman's discretion, and affiliates are expressly covered. However, the licence fails the fallback on transferability: it is expressly "non-transferable", Section 3(c) bars assignment or transfer without Garman's written consent, and Section 20(d) requires consent for any assignment, with no successor/M&A carve-out. Contractors acting on our behalf are also unaddressed. The redline adds contractors and outsourcing providers to the permitted user group and a consent-free assignment right to a successor in a merger or sale of the business, with a conforming cross-reference in Section 3(c); the Authorized Locations limitation is left intact.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to contractors acting for Sparkling and permit assignment to a successor in an M&A transaction.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence to contractors and outsourcing providers using the Software on our behalf, and added a consent-free assignment right to a successor in a merger or sale of the business, with a conforming carve-out in Section 3(c). Our playbook requires licences to cover affiliates and contractors and to travel with the business; the licence otherwise remains limited to the Authorized Locations.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors and outsourcing providers acting on Sparkling's behalf, in each case operating at Authorized Locations

ops.oldText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: except as permitted by Section 20(d) or as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;

ops.oldText: without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: without the written consent of the other party, provided that either party may assign this Agreement, together with the licence granted hereunder, without consent to a successor in connection with a merger, amalgamation, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates.
